summary: Apply knowledge audits, SECI mapping, and practical handover methods in five days. Explore the foundation course and outline.
lede: Knowledge management principles and practices help teams capture, share, retain, and apply operational know-how as usable work guidance. For knowledge coordinators, process owners, team leads, and specialists, this course offers practical ways to make critical knowledge available during handovers and daily work. Participants map knowledge flows, conduct knowledge audits, assess retention risks, and review lessons and article quality to improve how teams find and use guidance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for capturing, maintaining, transferring, or applying operational knowledge in teams and business processes.
modules: Knowledge Flows and the SECI Model
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a work process, team handover, procedure, or lessons-learned activity is recommended. Coding is not required.
